nosotros.subtitulo: More than two years accompanying the companies and workers of Quindío

mision.texto: We are a company dedicated to providing comprehensive social security solutions, facilitating affiliation and advisory processes for individuals and companies in Quindío. We are committed to quality, transparency and efficiency in every service, contributing to the well-being and social protection of our community.

vision.texto: To be recognized by 2030 as the leading company in social security management in the Eje Cafetero region, standing out for our technological innovation, service excellence and permanent commitment to the well-being of our clients and their employees.

contacto.subtitulo: We are here to help you. Get in touch with us

chatbot.bienvenida: Hello, welcome to Anturi Multiservicios. I am your virtual assistant. How can I help you today?

respuestas.servicios: We offer: EPS, Pension, ARL and Family Compensation Fund affiliations. We also provide social security consulting, cadastre and document management.
respuestas.afiliacion: To enroll you must bring your national ID, latest utility bill, and if a company: RUT and Chamber of Commerce. Our process is fast and personalized.
respuestas.ubicacion: We are located at Carrera 7 # 15-24, Quimbaya, Quindío. You can also contact us via WhatsApp.
respuestas.horarios: We serve Monday to Friday from 8:00 am to 6:00 pm. Saturdays from 8:00 am to 12:00 pm.
respuestas.documentos: Basic documents: National ID card. For companies: RUT, Chamber of Commerce, employee payroll. Additional documents may be required depending on the service.
respuestas.costos: The cost varies depending on the service and number of people. We offer free consultation to guide you. Contact us!
respuestas.asesor: We will connect you with one of our advisors via WhatsApp.
